players.product: retail colocation & interconnection (IBX data centers, Equinix Fabric) and xScale hyperscale data centers

quarterly_data.signal: Equinix's 10-K states approximately $13.6 billion of revenues, including deferred installation revenues, are expected to be recognized in future periods from unsatisfied performance obligations as of December 31, 2025, with approximately 65% expected to be recognized over the next two years. The figure excludes variable consideration such as metered power usage and xScale service fees based on future events.
quarterly_data.figure: remaining performance obligations ~$13.6 billion (December 31, 2025); ~65% over the next two years

quarterly_data.signal: As of December 31, 2025 Equinix had approximately $6.3 billion of unaccrued capital expenditure contractual commitments, primarily for real estate purchases, IBX infrastructure equipment not yet delivered and labor not yet provided for IBX data center expansion projects, the majority payable within the next 12 months.
